issue: New entry not persisted across page reload
actual: Created entry "Alpha QA task" (Priority 42, Mar 5 2026, Completed checked, Notes "note one"); it appeared immediately and count went 5 -> 6 entries. After reloading http://localhost:7074/, statusbar shows "5 entries", the entry is absent, and the added "Notes" field is also gone (headers back to Task Name/Priority/Due Date/Completed).
evidence: Post-reload DOM scan: count="5 entries", hasAlpha=false

Fields dialog offers type select with options Text/Number/Date/Checkbox. Added field "Notes" (Text); it immediately appeared as a table column header, in the card view (value "—"), in the sort dropdown, and in the Add Entry form as a text input.
Field config type select labels: "Text", "Number", "Date", "Checkbox". Entry form controls resolve to input[type=text], input[type=number], input[type=date], and button[role=checkbox] respectively.

Saved entry "Alpha QA task" / 42 / 2026-03-05 / Completed=checked / Notes="note one". Table shows: Alpha QA task | 42 | Mar 5, 2026 | check icon | note one. Cards show same: 42, Mar 5 2026, "Yes", "note one".
Switching Table -> Cards -> Table kept 6 entries and identical field values in both views (count stays "6 entries").
Priority field is input[type=number]. Typing "abc" character-by-character left value "0" (unchanged, validity.valid=true); typing "42" was accepted and saved/displayed as 42.

Due Date field is input[type=date]. Typing invalid segments "13"/"45" was clamped to a valid date (value "52026-12-04", validity.valid=true, badInput=false) — no invalid date can be stored. Valid date 2026-03-05 saved and rendered as "Mar 5, 2026".
All 6 entries and all 5 field values match between table and card views. Empty Notes value renders as an em dash "—" in both views.
Entry form: button[role=checkbox] with observable value true/false. Table: green "check" icon when true vs muted "x" icon when false. Cards: "Yes" vs "No".

Cards: sorted by Task Name asc, re-selecting toggled to desc ("Sorted by Task Name (descending)"). Switched to Table: sort reset to none, then clicking Priority header gave "Sorted by Priority (ascending)" with correct order. Switching back to Cards restored "Sorted by Task Name (descending)" — independent per-view sort state confirmed.
Across asc/desc Task Name and asc Priority sorts, count stayed "6 entries" and every field value (Priority/Due Date/Completed/Notes) per entry was unchanged; only row order differed.

Selecting "Task Name" in the Sort menu immediately reordered cards alphabetically; status bar reported "Sorted by Task Name (ascending)" and the sort button showed the field name with an arrow-up icon. Re-selecting flipped to descending. All other controls (view switch, search, add entry) remained functional afterwards.

actual: The app exposes only: Fields, Sort, Table/Cards view toggle, Add Entry and a free-text search box. No filter control exists anywhere (full-DOM scan: no element or text matching /filter/i; complete button list is toolbar.fields, toolbar.sort, toolbar.view.table, toolbar.view.cards, toolbar.add-entry). Field-specific filter criteria cannot be defined or cleared.
No filter UI exists (see FT-6), so active-criteria inclusion and filter-clearing behavior cannot be exercised at all.

No import UI exists: full-DOM scan found 0 input[type=file] elements and no text matching /import/i, and the Configure Fields dialog contains only a new-field name box, type select, Add button and the existing field list. Importing data after defining a schema, and type-mismatch rejection, cannot be performed.

issue: Quick search matches raw stored values, not the displayed values
actual: The entry "Alpha QA task" displays Due Date as "Mar 5, 2026" and Completed as "Yes". Searching the displayed date "Mar 5, 2026" returned "0 entries matching"; searching the raw value "2026-03-05" returned "1 entry". Searching the displayed checkbox state "Yes" returned "0 entries matching \"Yes\"" although 3 entries display Completed = Yes.

evidence: Query "MARKETING" (uppercase) matched "Review marketing materials" and the status bar showed "1 entry matching \"MARKETING\"". Clearing the box restored all 6 cards and "6 entries".

With sort cleared, drag handles are present in both views. Cards: moved "Alpha QA task" from position 6 to 5 -> [Design, Review, Update, Prepare, Alpha, Team sync]. Switched to Table (sort cleared): order was still the original [Design, Review, Update, Prepare, Team sync, Alpha], unaffected by the card reorder; moved "Design new landing page" down one -> [Review, Design, ...]. Switching back to Cards showed the card view's own order [Design, Review, Update, Prepare, Alpha, Team sync] — per-view manual orders retained independently.
